Game Overview

Scala 40 is a card game built around quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Playing Scala 40 comes down to a simple loop. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Scala 40?

Scala 40 is a free card game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Scala 40 free to play?

Yes, Scala 40 is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
